title: Send from a number group with sticky sender
summary: A number group created with sticky_sender true is a pool the platform picks From numbers out of, holding one per recipient. A compat send names the group as MessagingServiceSid and carries no From.
scenario: A bike shop texting repair updates from several numbers, where each customer should keep seeing the same one

evidence: tools/openapi/rest.json POST /api/relay/rest/number_groups: name required; sticky_sender boolean default false
tools/openapi/compat.json POST Messages: To required; From or MessagingServiceSid
https://signalwire.com/docs/compatibility-api/rest/messages/create-message (fetched 2026-09-02): MessagingServiceSid is the ID of a number group
sdk rest/namespaces/number_groups.py create, add_membership; compat.py CompatMessages.create
